ruview.connection_interrupted: Connection interrupted. Your entries are preserved. Actions require a successful permission check before continuing.
ruview.profile_help: Choose the flash size, not PSRAM: N16R8 means 16 MB flash and 8 MB PSRAM. For “USB JTAG/serial debug unit” choose cdc; for a USB-UART bridge choose uart.
ruview.flash_size_mismatch: Detected: {detected} MB flash. Selected profile: {expected} MB. Choose the matching profile; nothing was written.
ruview.step_configure: Step 2: Set up Wi-Fi and receiver
ruview.step_configure_help: After flashing, enter Wi-Fi and receiver settings and select “Set up board”. Reconnect the board after it restarts, then select “Confirm after restart”.
ruview.confirm_first: First confirm the settings after restart in step 2.
ruview.bootloader_failed: Cannot reach the bootloader. Hold BOOT while reconnecting, release BOOT afterwards and close other programs using the serial port.
ruview.flash_failed: Flashing failed. Check the USB connection and board profile. Details:
ruview.receiver_detected_help: These addresses come from saved settings or the RuView computer’s network interfaces. Use the address your board can reach over Wi-Fi. Reception is confirmed only by “Check sensor data”.
ruview.receiver_manual_help: Find the RuView computer in your router’s network/device list. For Docker, use the Docker host’s LAN IP. For an external instance, use that computer, not the PC connected to the USB board.
ruview.receiver_lookup_failed: Receiver settings could not be loaded. You can enter the address manually.
ruview.receiver_udp_disabled: UDP reception is still off. Enable it in RuView settings and allow the board addresses before checking sensor data.
ruview.readonly_notice: Read only blocks starts, changes and deletions. Administrators can stop the service, recording and training.
ruview.receiver_purpose: In managed Docker mode, AuraGo connects to the RuView service automatically. Only ESP32 boards need the IP: they send to the RuView computer's LAN address, not a container IP.
ruview.receiver_suggestion_help: Suggested from your settings or browser URL. Check that the board can reach this computer over Wi-Fi. A proxy or tunnel may require a different LAN address.
ruview.erase: Erase all settings and recordings on this board
ruview.node_suggested: Suggested free ID: {id}. Boards not reported by the service are not included.
ruview.node_exhausted: All IDs (1–255) are reported as occupied. Enter an existing ID only to reconfigure that board.
ruview.node_lookup_failed: Could not check existing node IDs. Enter an unused ID from 1 to 255 manually.
ruview.flashed: Step 1 complete: firmware written and verified. Now set up Wi-Fi and the receiver in step 2.
ruview.reconnect: Reconnect the board after restart, then confirm
ruview.save_first: Save changes before testing or configuring boards.
ruview.quality: Experimental Wi-Fi motion detection (radar, including through walls). RSSI needs a supported host adapter; CSI needs optional ESP32 boards. Demo data is labelled. Model/LoRA switching is unavailable in this upstream version.
ruview.prerequisites: Use HTTPS or localhost and a browser with Web Serial enabled. Close other serial tools; use a data-capable USB cable. Hold BOOT while reconnecting if detection fails.
ruview.privacy: Wi-Fi credentials stay only in browser memory and go directly to the board. Setup, retries and checks keep your entries. Closing the dialog clears them.
ruview.board_mismatch: The chip, flash size and USB console must match the selected profile. Choose a supported S3 4/8/16 MiB or C6 4 MiB board.
ruview.verification_failed: Verification failed. Nothing is retried automatically. Check the firmware files, USB connection and board before another attempt.
ruview.serial_unsupported: Use HTTPS or localhost and a browser with Web Serial enabled. Close other serial tools; use a data-capable USB cable. Hold BOOT while reconnecting if detection fails.
ruview.serial_timeout: Use HTTPS or localhost and a browser with Web Serial enabled. Close other serial tools; use a data-capable USB cable. Hold BOOT while reconnecting if detection fails.
ruview.serial_disconnected: Reconnect the board after restart, then confirm
ruview.serial_closed: Reconnect the board after restart, then confirm
ruview.unknown_usb: The chip, flash size and USB console must match the selected profile. Choose a supported S3 4/8/16 MiB or C6 4 MiB board.
ruview.wrong_console: The USB connection does not match the board profile. For “USB JTAG/serial debug unit”, choose a “cdc” profile; for a USB-UART bridge, choose “uart”.
ruview.wrong_chip: The chip, flash size and USB console must match the selected profile. Choose a supported S3 4/8/16 MiB or C6 4 MiB board.
ruview.wrong_flash: The chip, flash size and USB console must match the selected profile. Choose a supported S3 4/8/16 MiB or C6 4 MiB board.
ruview.invalid_firmware: The firmware profile is invalid or incompatible with this AuraGo version. Nothing was written. Check the installed resource package.
ruview.checksum_failed: The firmware file does not match its checksum. Nothing was written. Check the installed AuraGo resource package.
ruview.write_verify_failed: Firmware readback differs from the written data. Check the USB cable and board before flashing again.
ruview.invalid_nonce: Reconnect the board after restart, then confirm
ruview.invalid_reply: Verification failed. Nothing is retried automatically. Check the firmware files, USB connection and board before another attempt.
ruview.readback_failed: Verification failed. Nothing is retried automatically. Check the firmware files, USB connection and board before another attempt.
ruview.serial_overflow: Reconnect the board after restart, then confirm
ruview.erase_required: This board has a different partition layout. Tick “Erase all settings and recordings on this board” to replace it; this deletes settings and recordings on the board.
ruview.firmware_missing: Firmware files are missing or could not be loaded. Check the installed AuraGo resource package.
ruview.configure_first: Select “Set up board” first. You can then confirm the settings on the restarted board.
ruview.no_frames: No fresh CSI data from this board yet. Check Wi-Fi, the receiver address and UDP access.
ruview.unexpected_simulation: RuView sends simulated data although real sensing is configured.
ruview.invalid_wifi: Wi-Fi network (SSID): 1–32 UTF-8 B; Wi-Fi password: 8–63 UTF-8 B.
ruview.source_mismatch: RuView reports a different signal source than configured.
ruview.fusion_notice: Pose-Fusion uses untrained example models. Its visualization and confidence scores are not validated measurements.
ruview.mode_help_docker: AuraGo manages RuView in Docker. Suitable for ESP32 boards or a demo.
ruview.mode_help_external: Connect an existing RuView instance. Install and start it on its own computer.
ruview.mode_help_native: For Wi-Fi adapters on Windows or macOS. If AuraGo runs in Docker or on Linux, choose an external instance.
ruview.source_help_esp32: Real CSI measurements with optional ESP32-S3 or ESP32-C6 boards. Set them up over USB below.
ruview.source_help_wifi: Motion detection using the RuView computer's Wi-Fi adapter. Requires Windows or macOS and a native or external instance.
ruview.source_help_simulated: Try it without hardware. All generated data is explicitly labelled as demo data.
ruview.readonly_help: Read only blocks starts, changes and deletions. Administrators can stop the service, recording and training.
ruview.agent_help: The agent can only read status and measurements. It cannot configure boards or start recordings.
ruview.token_help: Optional for protected external instances. Encrypted in the Vault when you save.
ruview.managed_help: Save your settings and open RuView to install or start the runtime.
ruview.setup_help: Choose receiver → save settings → connect board over USB → set up firmware and Wi-Fi → check sensor data.
ruview.receiver_help: Private IPv4 address of the computer running RuView, reachable by the board over Wi-Fi. Example: 192.168.1.20.
ruview.udp_help: Allows sensor data from your boards. Choose the local LAN address and the allowed board addresses.
ruview.udp_allow_help: Separate board addresses with commas. A whole network is also supported, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24.
ruview.enable_first: Enable RuView and save your settings before continuing.
ruview.write_first: Turn off Read only above and save to set up a board.
ruview.wifi_mode: Host Wi-Fi requires a native or external instance. Choose that runtime or another data source.
ruview.devices_stale: Refresh failed. The last data is stale.
ruview.process_exited: The service exited. You can start it again.
ruview.stop_failed: Could not confirm the stop. Check the service.
ruview.devices_known: Known boards remain visible without reception. Current CSI data is indicated separately.
ruview.devices_empty: No boards saved yet. Previously configured boards are added when they next send data; flashing again is not necessary.
ruview.device_save_failed: Board settings confirmed, but the device list could not be saved. Repeat the confirmation.
ruview.external_runtime: Start and stop an external instance on its own computer.
ruview.install_native: Install is available only for the native runtime.
ruview.udp_operator: UDP reception is handled by the external RuView instance.
ruview.recording_unconfirmed: Last recording action was not confirmed
ruview.recording_note: This is the last confirmed action of this AuraGo session, not the service state.
ruview.session_not_started: Not started in this session. Start the service with the button below, or restart AuraGo.
ruview.devices_not_applicable: The board list is only used with ESP32 boards.
ruview.devices_not_running: The RuView service is not running. Saved boards are shown without live data.
ruview.headline_readonly_blocked: RuView is read-only, so the service can't start.
ruview.headline_not_installed: RuView isn't installed on this computer yet.
ruview.headline_starting_pull: Starting RuView: downloading the service image…
ruview.headline_stop_failed: Stopping wasn't confirmed. RuView may still be running.
ruview.headline_external_unchecked: External RuView service, not checked yet.
ruview.headline_external_check_old: External RuView service, last checked {age} ago.
ruview.headline_demo: Demo mode: simulated data, not measurements.
ruview.headline_waiting: RuView is running and waiting for data from the boards.
ruview.headline_waiting_wifi: RuView is running and waiting for the first Wi-Fi data.
ruview.headline_disconnected: RuView is running, but its signal source is disconnected.
ruview.headline_live_board: Working: live data from {n} board, last {age} ago.
ruview.headline_live_boards: Working: live data from {n} boards, last {age} ago.
ruview.headline_live_wifi: Working: this computer's Wi-Fi signal, last {age} ago.
ruview.secondary_status_last_known: Showing the last known state from {time}.
ruview.secondary_off: RuView detects motion from Wi-Fi signals. Turn it on in the settings.
ruview.secondary_readonly_blocks: Read-only blocks starting, board setup, recording, training and deleting. Stopping stays possible.
ruview.secondary_install: Install downloads and checks the pinned package. Nothing starts automatically.
ruview.secondary_phase_step: Step {n} of {total} · can take minutes the first time
ruview.secondary_stop_hint: AuraGo recorded a hint in the planner.
ruview.secondary_demo: Choose ESP32 or Wi-Fi in settings for real sensing.
ruview.stop_reason_process_exit: The service ended on its own.
ruview.phase_waiting_ready: waiting for the service to answer
ruview.reason_wait_start: Wait for the start to finish.
ruview.err_readonly: RuView is read-only, so this change is blocked.
ruview.err_external_runtime: An external RuView service is started and stopped on its own computer.
ruview.err_docker_readonly: RuView can't start: the Docker integration is off or read-only.
ruview.err_already_running: RuView is already running. Stop it before starting again.
ruview.err_not_installed: RuView isn't installed on this computer yet.
ruview.err_busy: RuView is busy with another start or installation. Wait for it to finish.
ruview.err_cancelled: The action was cancelled by a stop or a settings change.
ruview.err_container_conflict: A container named aurago-ruview belongs to another AuraGo installation. Remove or rename it in Docker, then start again.
ruview.err_platform_unsupported: There is no verified RuView package for this computer's system.
ruview.err_invalid_node_id: The board number must be between 1 and 255.
ruview.err_invalid_config: The RuView settings don't allow this. Check them in the settings.
ruview.err_docker_unavailable: RuView can't start: Docker can't be reached.
ruview.err_image_denied: RuView can't start: the registry denied the service image.
ruview.err_image_pull_failed: RuView can't start: the service image could not be downloaded.
ruview.err_contract_unsupported: RuView answered in a format this AuraGo version doesn't support.
ruview.err_download_failed: The RuView package could not be downloaded or failed its check.
ruview.err_stop_failed: Stopping wasn't confirmed. RuView may still be running.
ruview.err_source_mismatch: RuView uses a different signal source than set in AuraGo.
ruview.err_unexpected_simulation: RuView is sending simulated data although real sensing is set.
ruview.err_storage_unreadable: RuView's storage folder can't be checked, so the storage budget isn't enforced.
ruview.err_storage_full: The RuView storage budget is full, so recording is stopped.
ruview.err_artifact_missing: This AuraGo release has no verified RuView package for this.
ruview.err_network: AuraGo can't be reached. Check the connection.
ruview.err_forbidden: You don't have permission for this.
ruview.recording_last: Last confirmed action: {action} at {time} (this AuraGo session)
ruview.diagnostics_failed: Copying failed. Select the text below and copy it.
ruview.quality_short: Wi-Fi sensing is experimental and does not prove presence.
ruview.allow_changes_body: Read-only currently blocks starting the service, setting up boards, recording, training and deleting. This saves “read-only: off” in the RuView settings. Stopping works either way. You can turn read-only back on in the settings.
ruview.allow_changes_failed: The setting could not be saved.
ruview.lab_intro: Original RuView pages for experiments. They are in English, may show unverified claims and open only when you choose them.
ruview.lab_observatory_desc: Upstream 3D view of the sensing field.
ruview.lab_pose_fusion_desc: Experimental pose estimate from CSI with untrained example models.
ruview.lab_dashboard_desc: The upstream dashboard, including recording, training and the model library.
ruview.lab_req_csi: Needs live CSI; demo only with the demo source.
ruview.lab_req_any: Works with any source and shows waiting states without data.
